[TOC]

### Prerequisites:

- MDVR host, remote control, display screen.

### Operation steps

1. Power on and enter the remote control menu>>Tools>>Operation Management>>Language and Restart Interface
![](http://pug2.4000329988.com/server/index.php?s=/api/attachment/visitFile&sign=f800241cc7c36aba8d64b4e63b5959ab)
![](http://pug2.4000329988.com/server/index.php?s=/api/attachment/visitFile&sign=0234bd6710bf39ffd53e2a96608acaa0)
![](http://pug2.4000329988.com/server/index.php?s=/api/attachment/visitFile&sign=df9347f70209dc8963a168196663d950)
2. Move to the language drop-down box to select the language. When the restart dialog box pops up, select Yes to restart the device to take effect.
![](http://pug2.4000329988.com/server/index.php?s=/api/attachment/visitFile&sign=a1be87d42b8f17b04d77263a5e4cd95c)
ps: Currently the device supports 4 UI languages
